style:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Ubuntu:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,700;1,300;1,400;1,500;1,700&display=swap');
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Anton&family=Anton+SC&family=Bree+Serif&family=Orelega+One&family=Patua+One&family=Protest+Strike&display=swap');

  :root {
    font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;

    /*
    Set your paper size here

    Default: A4
      A4 Paper is 210mm x 297mm
      A3 Paper is 297mm x 420mm
      Letter Paper is 8.5in x 11in
    */

    /* NOTE: Inverted because we want landscape */
    --paper-width: {{ paperHeight }};
    --paper-height: {{ paperWidth }};

    --stamp-container-width: 5in;
    --stamp-container-height: 2.59in;

    --items-per-row: 2;
    --rows-per-page: 3;

    --paper-margin-x: calc(
      (var(--paper-width) - var(--items-per-row) * var(--stamp-container-width)) /
        2
    );
    --paper-margin-y: calc(
      (
          var(--paper-height) - var(--rows-per-page) *
            var(--stamp-container-height)
        ) / 2
    );

    /* Page is the internal usable space (i.e. with margins subtracted). */
    --page-width: calc(var(--paper-width) - var(--paper-margin-x) * 2);
    --page-height: calc(var(--paper-height) - var(--paper-margin-y) * 2);

    --background-color: #000;
    --text-color: #fff;
    --primary-color: #82d853;
  }

  /**
   * Page Settings
   */
  @page {
    size: {{ paperSize }} landscape;
    /* Chrome sets own margins, we change these printer settings */
    margin-top: var(--paper-margin-y);
    /* See HACK above as to why this is zero. */
    margin-bottom: 0;
    margin-left: var(--paper-margin-x);
    margin-right: var(--paper-margin-x);
  }

  body {
    width: var(--page-width);
    min-height: calc(var(--page-height) + var(--paper-margin-y));
    margin: 0;
    padding-top: var(--paper-margin-y);
    /* See HACK above as to why this is zero. */
    padding-bottom: 0;
    padding-left: var(--paper-margin-x);
    padding-right: var(--paper-margin-x);
    display: flex;
    align-content: flex-start;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    font-size:9px;
    font-family: Ubuntu;
  }

  @media print {
    body {
      width: var(--page-width);
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }
  }

  .stamp-container {
    /* Set this as a block element */
    display: block;

    /* Do not exceed the width and height due to padding and margins */
    box-sizing: border-box;

    /* Stamp size */
    width: var(--stamp-container-width);
    height: var(--stamp-container-height);

    /* Stop stamps from being broken in half between pages */
    break-inside: avoid;

    /* Center the stamp inside of the stamp container */
    display: grid;
    align-items: start;
    justify-items: center;
  }

  .stamp-inner {
    position: relative;

    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;

    background: url('./templates/minisatoshi-v2.svg');
    background-size: cover;
    background-position: center;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;

    /* Do not exceed the width and height due to padding and margins */
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

  /* Row class - container for columns */
  .row {
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
  }

  /* Column class - each panel of the trifold */
  .column {
    flex: 1;
    /*border: 1px dotted #F00;*/
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

  .left-pane {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    /* Don't grow or shrink, use the specified width */
    width: 30%;
    padding-right: 0.8%;
  }

  .center-pane {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    /* Don't grow or shrink, use the specified width */
    width: 38.5%;
  }

  .right-pane {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    /* Don't grow or shrink, use the specified width */
    width: 31.5%;
    padding-left: 0.5%;
  }

  .left-pane-content {
    text-align: center;
  }

  .center-pane-content {
    text-align: center;
    padding-top: 2mm;
    padding-left: 4mm;
    padding-right: 4mm;
    font-weight: bold;
  }

  .center-pane-content p {
    margin: 1mm;
  }

  .right-pane-content {
    text-align: center;
  }

  .qr-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 1mm;
    margin-top: 1mm;
    margin-bottom: 1mm;
    margin-left: 5mm;
    margin-right: 5mm;
  }

  .left-pane-qr-container {
    margin-top: 8mm;
    margin-bottom: 3mm;
  }

  .right-pane-qr-container {
    margin-top: 13.0mm;
  }

  .step {
    color: #fff;
    line-height: 17px;
    text-shadow: 1px 1px black;
  }

  .qr {
    margin-top: 0px;
  }

  .qr-code {
    margin: auto;
    width: 24mm !important;
    height: 24mm !important;
  }

  .step-heading {
    font-size: 14px;
    margin-bottom: 1mm;
    font-weight: bold;
    text-shadow:
      -1px -1px 0 #81e348,
      -1px 0px 0 #81e348,
      -1px 1px 0 #81e348,
      0px -1px 0 #81e348,
      0px 1px 0 #81e348,
      1px -1px 0 #81e348,
      1px 0px 0 #81e348,
      1px 1px 0 #81e348;
  }

  .step-subheading {
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #fff;
    text-shadow:
      -1px -1px 0 black,
      -1px 0px 0 black,
      -1px 1px 0 black,
      0px -1px 0 black,
      0px 1px 0 black,
      1px -1px 0 black,
      1px 0px 0 black,
      1px 1px 0 black;
  }

  .do-not-expose {
    margin-top: 3mm;
    margin-left: 10mm;
    font-weight: bold;
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  .valid-until {
    margin-top: 2mm;
    color: #000;
    font-size: 8px;
    font-family: 'monospace';
  }

  .stamp-number {
    position: absolute;
    top: 2mm;
    right: 2mm;
    color: #000;
    text-align: left;
    font-size: 8px;
    font-family: 'monospace';
  }
</style>
